name: Fallen
journal: I died, and woke falling out of the sky. Men with nets were waiting.

steps.text: Locked in the finders' cage.
The bars are broken. Take Hanne's sword from where she fell and fight off the goblins.
Follow the road west to Hearthmere and find Mira at the Adventurers Guild.

name: Clear the Slimes
journal: Pip's notice: the slimes have crept out of the Slime Fields onto the north road and eat through his sacks of seed. The Guild pays for every five cleared.

steps.text: Kill slimes in the Slime Fields north-west of the village.
Return to the Guild and report to Mira.

place: the Slime Fields north-west of the village

name: Goblin Bounty
journal: Garrick's notice: goblins from Goblin Hollow have been robbing carts on the north road. A bounty on every three.

steps.text: Kill goblins at Goblin Hollow, north-east of the village.
Return to the Guild and report to Mira.

place: Goblin Hollow north-east of the village

name: Gel for the Alchemist
journal: Wren's notice: her potions need slime gel, and she has run out. Slimes drop it in the Slime Fields north-west of the village.

steps.text: Gather Slime Gel from slimes in the Slime Fields and bring it to Mira.

name: Hides for Harrow Farm
journal: Hamm's notice: winter is coming and Harrow Farm needs deer hides for coats. Deer graze the meadows round the village; they bolt, so come at them quietly.

steps.text: Hunt deer in the meadows and bring their hides to Mira.

name: Proof of the Hunt
journal: Corwin's notice: the Guild wants goblin teeth as proof that the camps at Goblin Hollow are being thinned.

steps.text: Take goblin teeth at Goblin Hollow and bring them to Mira.

name: Wolves at Greyfang
place: Greyfang Forest south-east of the valley
journal: Garrick's notice: the Greyfang pack has taken sheep from the south pastures twice this week. Thin the pack in Greyfang Forest.

steps.text: Kill wolves in Greyfang Forest, south-east of the valley.
Return to the Guild and report to Mira.

name: Orc Scouts at the Outpost
journal: Corwin's notice: orc scouts from the Ironjaw Warcamp have set up an outpost past East Watch. Drive them off before more come.

steps.text: Kill orcs at the Ironjaw Outpost, north-east past East Watch.
Return to the Guild and report to Mira.

name: Something Howls in Moonfell
journal: Old Bram's notice: something howls in the ruins of Moonfell at night, and a shepherd did not come home. Find it and kill it.

steps.text: Kill a werewolf in the ruins of Moonfell, south-west of the valley.
Return to the Guild and report to Mira.

name: Fire in the Archive
place: the Sunken Archive behind Silver Falls
journal: Wren's notice: goblins have dug into an old Auren library in a cave beside Silver Falls, and their shaman is burning the books for warmth. Stop him before nothing is left.

steps.text: Enter the cave beside Silver Falls and kill the goblin shaman in the Sunken Archive.
Return to the Guild and report to Mira.

name: Into the Warren
place: the Goblin Warren under Goblin Hollow
journal: Corwin's notice: the goblins of the Hollow have a burrow beside their fort, and their brutes come up out of it to raid. Go down and break them.

steps.text: Go down the burrow beside the goblin fort and kill brutes in the Goblin Warren.
Return to the Guild and report to Mira.

name: Hares for the Pot
journal: Tobb's notice, in a shaky hand: the perch have stopped biting and an old man cannot live on hope. Three hares for the pot, and he'll pay what he has.

steps.text: Hunt brown hares in the open meadows and bring their meat to Mira.

name: Raiders at the Fold
brief: kill 3 goblins at the Westwood camp
place: the goblin camp in Westwood, west along the King's Road
journal: Brin's notice: goblins from the camp past the burnt farm took three of her ewes last spring and have been watching the fold again. Drive them off before they try.

steps.text: Kill goblins at the camp in Westwood, west along the King's Road past Shepherd's Croft.
Return to the Guild and report to Mira.

name: Crows over Crowfield
place: Crowfield, on the road to Moonfell
journal: Garrick's notice: the crows on the old battlefield have grown bold enough to go for travellers on the Moonfell road. Thin them out.

steps.text: Kill carrion crows on Crowfield, the old battlefield beside the Moonfell road. Strike them when they dive.
Return to the Guild and report to Mira.

name: Lookout at the Old Watchtower
brief: kill 2 goblins at the Old Watchtower
place: the Old Watchtower in the Northern Wilds
journal: Garrick's notice: goblin archers have taken the old border tower in the north for a lookout and watch every road out of the valley. Pull them down.

steps.text: Kill the goblin archers who keep the Old Watchtower, far north in the Northern Wilds.
Return to the Guild and report to Mira.

name: Thornback Tracks
place: the Emerald Jungle north-west of the village
journal: Oswin's notice: thornbacks have come out of the jungle as far as the creek. One charged his cart. Step aside when they charge, he says, and let them meet a tree.

steps.text: Kill thornbacks in the Emerald Jungle. Step aside from a charge, ideally in front of a tree.
Return to the Guild and report to Mira.

name: Lights at the Stone Circle
journal: Old Bram's notice: lights dance among the standing stones after dark again, as they did when he was a boy. Put them out. Stand by the stones when they shoot; the stones remember what they were raised for.

steps.text: Go to the Stone Circle after dark and put out three barrow wisps. Standing by a stone dims them.
Return to the Guild and report to Mira.

name: Bandits on Mirror Way
place: Bandit Hollow in the woods west of the Last Lantern
journal: Marta's notice: travellers on Mirror Way are robbed in the woods west of her inn, and the last one came in with an arrow in his pack. Red Hand Garrow's crew camp in a hollow there.

steps.text: Kill bandits in Bandit Hollow, in the woods west of the Last Lantern on Mirror Way.
Return to the Guild and report to Mira.
